selected.titulo: Google Assistant will disappear from your phone next month
selected.resumen:
Farewell, Google Assistant art, we hardly knew ye. | Illustration by Alex Castro / The Verge	

Google Assistant's days have been numbered ever since Gemini arrived on the scene, and its time is now up. Google has announced that it will be removing access to Assistant on Android phones and tablets, along with paired devices like smartwatches or headphones, from September 4th.

selected.titulo: Elon Musk’s attempt at an AI Wikipedia hasn’t been updated in months
selected.resumen:
xAI's Grokipedia, an online encyclopedia with AI-generated articles that Elon Musk once promised would be a "massive improvement" over Wikipedia, apparently hasn't been updated since April 24th, according to a report from Lawfare. "As far as we can tell, no entry has changed in more than three months," Lawfare said.
